Version 1.0 · Design revision 7 refinement 2 · Static design reference, not a browser screenshot
Collection: when data arrives or is requested. Freshness: whether it is recent enough.
Evaluation: when rules run. Recheck evidence and authority before consequential dispatch.
Illustrative metric plan: poll 30 seconds · maximum age 120 seconds · reconcile 300 seconds
Urgent changes and evidence expiry bypass routine delay. Missing signals never mean healthy.
Prepare local timing plan → Discard local timing plan
No collector, scheduler or cloud request is activated. Source resolution and quotas still apply.
